description:
**About Us**
Planful is the pioneer of financial performance management cloud software. The Planful platform, which helps businesses drive peak financial performance, is used around the globe to streamline business-wide planning, budgeting, consolidations, reporting, and analytics. Planful's award-winning AI capabilities accelerate decision-making, helping Planful users in over 100 countries close faster, accelerate cycle times, increase productivity, and improve accuracy. Planful is a private company with more than 1,500 customers, including Bose, Boston Red Sox, Five Guys, Grafton Plc, Gousto, and Specialized, and is backed by Vector Capital, a leading global private equity firm. Learn more at Planful.com.
  
  
**About The Role**
We're looking for a Technical Content Writer to join our Content team and own content for our AI-first platform. This is a build-from-the-ground-up opportunity: redefining how our users interact with AI-driven planning and analytics, and the content you create will shape how customers understand, trust, and adopt AI-native workflows — from conversational interfaces to autonomous agents and AI-generated insights.
  
  
This role sits at the intersection of product, design, and engineering. You'll work in tight loops with Product Managers to understand what's shipping and why, with UX to make sure in-product language is clear and consistent, and with Engineers to accurately document how the AI capabilities actually work under the hood. You'll also be expected to work at AI-native speed: using Claude and other AI tools as a core part of your own workflow to draft, iterate, and scale content quality — while applying your subject-matter judgment, editorial standards, and domain expertise to everything that ships.
  
  
This is a high-visibility role for someone who wants to help define what great content looks like for an AI-first product, not just document features after the fact.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Own end-to-end content for AI-Platform, including in-product AI guidance (prompts, suggested actions, agent explanations), onboarding flows, release notes, and help documentation
* Partner closely with PMs to get early visibility into the roadmap and translate new AI capabilities into clear, accurate, user-facing content
* Collaborate with UX/Product Design on UI text, conversational flows, empty states, and error messaging for AI-driven interactions, ensuring tone and terminology stay consistent as the product evolves
* Work directly with Engineering to understand model behavior, limitations, and system design well enough to write content that's technically accurate — including how AI outputs are generated, their confidence/limitations, and any human-in-the-loop steps
* Use Claude and other AI writing tools as a primary part of your workflow to draft, restructure, and scale content, while maintaining rigorous human review for accuracy, tone, and domain correctness
* Develop and maintain a scalable content strategy for the AI-first platform, including reusable content patterns/templates for recurring AI features
* Produce release content for the monthly Agile release cycle (release notes, known issues, release highlights)
* Continuously audit existing content against product changes, flagging where AI behavior updates require content updates
* Help define content guidelines/voice standards for writing about AI features (e.g., how to describe confidence levels, model limitations, and autonomous actions to users)

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 3-6 years of experience researching, writing, and editing content for a software application in an Agile environment
* Demonstrated experience writing content for AI/ML-powered features or products (conversational UI, generative AI outputs, recommendation/agent systems, etc.)
* Hands-on experience using AI tools (e.g., Claude or similar LLM-based tools) as part of a content production workflow — drafting, editing, summarizing, or repurposing content at scale
* Comfort working directly with Engineering to understand technical/AI system behavior well enough to write about it accurately
* Experience partnering with UX/Product Design on in-product copy and interaction content
* Experience with wiki-based, industry-standard documentation tools (e.g., Confluence, Document360)
* Finance, EPM, multi-dimensional modeling, or planning software domain expertise is a strong plus
* Experience creating API documentation is a plus
* Experience with onboarding tools such as Pendo or WalkMe is a plus

Key Behaviors
  
  

* AI-fluent – comfortable using AI tools to accelerate content production without sacrificing quality, accuracy, or judgment
* Cross-functional – builds strong working relationships with PMs, UX, and Engineering, and knows how to pull the right context from each
* Proactive – makes things happen instead of waiting for direction; flags content gaps before they become problems
* Detail-oriented – manages multiple concurrent workstreams and releases with precision
* Customer-focused – keeps the end user's understanding and trust in AI features front of mind
* Accountability – owns tasks and outcomes end-to-end
* Team player – collaborates and shares learnings with the broader Content team

Why Planful
  
  
Planful Exists To Enrich The World By Helping Our Customers And Our People Achieve Peak Performance. To Foster The Best-in-class Work We're So Proud Of, We've Created a Best-in-class Culture, Including
  
  

* Volunteer days, Birthday PTO, and company-wide Wellness Days
* Supply of diapers and meal deliveries for the first month of your Maternity/Paternity leave
* Office hubs in Hyderabad and Indore, with home office setup allowance and monthly Wi-Fi/cell phone reimbursements
* Employee Resource Groups like Women of Planful, Parents of Planful, and more
* People Programs that foster connection and wellbeing, such as Movember, Summer Wellness, Breast Cancer Awareness Month, and Hispanic Heritage Month

description:

Oct 23, 2026 @Quadricit
  
  
Role summary
  
  
Quadric IT is hiring a senior Technical Writer with 12 to 15 years of experience as a full-time employee at our Hyderabad delivery center. You will document marketing technology platforms (Salesforce Data 360 and Marketing Cloud) and the data pipelines, APIs and integrations behind them for Quadric's client programs. The person writes controlled documents that engineers, marketers and auditors rely on, works with minimal supervision, and deals directly with senior technical stakeholders.

Technical Writer (MarTech & Data Platforms), Senior

Hyderabad, onsite or hybrid (both options available)
  
  
**Experience**
12 to 15 years in technical writing, ideally in regulated or enterprise settings

Quadric IT delivery lead, working day to day with client SMEs
  
  
Joining

Recruiter note, not for the posted ad: the reference role is written at mid level with 5+ years. Asking for 12 to 15 years makes this a senior hire. Salary is not a constraint for the right candidate, so do not screen out on expected CTC, and keep the advertised line as "highly competitive".
  
  
Key responsibilities
  
  
The writer owns documentation for the MarTech stack from first interview to approved, versioned document.
  
  

* Document MarTech platforms: create and maintain user guides, configuration guides and process documentation for Salesforce Data 360 (formerly Data Cloud), Salesforce Marketing Cloud and connected tools.
* Document data flows: describe data pipelines, data models, ingestion and transformation logic, identity resolution, segmentation and activation, with data lineage diagrams.
* Document APIs and integrations: write clear REST and SOAP API documentation, covering endpoints, authentication, request and response examples, error handling and integration specifications.
* Produce controlled documents: author SOPs, work instructions, system descriptions, release notes and change documentation in line with GDocP and company quality standards.
* Collaborate with SMEs: interview developers, data engineers, architects and marketers independently, then validate the content with them.
* Maintain the document lifecycle: manage versioning, reviews, approvals, periodic updates and archiving in a document management system.
* Support compliance: make sure documents support audit readiness (GxP where applicable, GDPR, privacy, consent management, data governance).
* Standardize content: define templates, style guides and a reusable knowledge base, and recommend improvements to documentation processes.
* Guide others: give informal guidance to colleagues and contributors on documentation standards and best practices.

Required qualifications
  
  
Candidates must meet all of these; the first two are the quickest screens.
  
  

* 12 to 15 years of technical writing experience, with at least 5 in a regulated or enterprise environment.
* Working knowledge of Good Documentation Practices (GDocP) and ALCOA+ principles.
* Proven record of independently documenting complex technical systems end to end.
* Ability to learn enterprise platforms quickly and turn them into clear documentation.
* Solid grasp of data and integration concepts: data models, APIs (REST and SOAP), JSON and XML, ETL and ELT, data pipelines.
* Excellent written English, strong attention to detail and the ability to simplify complex topics.
* Experience creating diagrams in tools such as Visio, Lucidchart or draw.io.
* Strong stakeholder management, including comfort challenging and clarifying input from senior technical staff.

Preferred qualifications
  
  
These raise a profile's rank but are not hard filters.
  
  

* Exposure to Salesforce products (Data 360, Marketing Cloud) or other MarTech and CDP tools; Trailhead badges or Salesforce certification is a plus.
* Experience documenting APIs with Postman, Swagger or OpenAPI.
* Ability to read basic SQL, JSON or code snippets.
* Knowledge of GDPR, CCPA, consent management and data privacy requirements.
* Experience in pharma, life sciences or other regulated industries (GxP, 21 CFR Part 11, CSV or CSA).
* Experience with Confluence, SharePoint, Veeva Vault, MadCap Flare or similar tools.
* Familiarity with Agile and DevOps workflows (Jira, Git-based docs, docs-as-code).
* Experience using AI-assisted documentation tools with strong review discipline.

Key competencies
  
  

* Autonomy: manages own workload and priorities with minimal supervision.
* Technical curiosity: quickly learns new platforms and architectures.
* Stakeholder management: works effectively across IT, marketing, data and quality teams.
* Accuracy and integrity: upholds data integrity and documentation standards.
* Ownership: self-driven, organized, and able to manage multiple deliverables.

Sourcing kit
  
  
Run these searches on LinkedIn Recruiter or Naukri RMS, filtered to Hyderabad (and Bengaluru or Pune for relocators) with 12 to 15 years of experience and a notice period under 30 days.

Boolean string

("technical writer" OR "senior technical writer" OR "principal technical writer" OR "documentation lead") AND (Salesforce OR "Data Cloud" OR "Data 360" OR "Marketing Cloud" OR MarTech OR CDP)
  
  
Regulated
  
  
("technical writer" OR "documentation") AND (GxP OR GDocP OR ALCOA OR "21 CFR Part 11" OR CSV OR pharma OR "life sciences") AND (API OR "data pipeline" OR integration)
  
  
API and data
  
  
("technical writer" OR "API documentation") AND (OpenAPI OR Swagger OR Postman) AND (ETL OR "data model" OR "data lineage" OR SQL)
  
  
Tools
  
  
("technical writer") AND (Confluence OR SharePoint OR "Veeva Vault" OR MadCap OR Flare) AND (Visio OR Lucidchart OR draw.io)
  
  
**Where to look:**
pharma and life-science global capability centres in Hyderabad, Salesforce implementation partners, large IT services firms with documentation practices, and CROs with data platform teams.
  
  
**Titles to include:**
Senior Technical Writer, Principal Technical Writer, Documentation Manager, Lead Content Developer, Information Developer, Technical Documentation Specialist, Validation Documentation Lead.
  
  
**Signals to favor:**
stable tenure with a growth path, availability within 30 days (buy-out support possible for the right candidate), willingness to work from Hyderabad, and a portfolio or sanitized samples on request.

You are someone who can greet a customer with warmth, persuasive & converts lead into sales. Why Join RED.Health • Competitive fixed salary with performance-linked incentives tied directly to your trip volumes and revenue achievement • Structured 4-day induction followed by a 45-day onboarding support framework — dedicated Cluster Manager check-ins, an onboarding buddy from the floor, and regular P&O support calls • Clear, performance-driven growth path — high performers who deliver on floor presence, revenue, and relationships are promoted fast, not based on tenure • You will work alongside trained paramedics, EMTs, and pilots operating ALS, BLS, NICU, Train, and Air Ambulance services across 34+ cities • This is work that visibly matters. * Own national commercial performance
* Translate national and city revenue targets into channel, territory and account plans.
* Diagnose performance gaps using account potential, referral activity, conversion, capacity and commercial economics.
* Identify the few actions most likely to close those gaps and hold clear owners accountable.
* Maintain a credible forecast and explain variances early.
* Allocate sales effort and approved budgets to opportunities with a clear rationale.
* Work with Finance and the Head of Growth on channel economics, investment decisions and corrective action.
* Build productive referral relationships
* Segment and prioritise doctors, clinics, hospitals and other relevant partners based on clinical relevance, account potential and relationship stage.
* Understand their unmet needs, referral barriers and current alternatives.
* Develop account plans with a specific proposition, next action, owner and date.
* Activate appropriate new accounts, deepen productive relationships and re-engage lapsed referrers.
* Work with Sukoon clinicians to build professional trust through meaningful conversations and evidence.
* Ensure partners understand referral pathways and receive timely follow-through from the relevant teams.
* Explore partnerships where they support the agreed growth strategy.
* Assess fit, expected demand, delivery requirements, economics and ownership before proposing an investment.
* Referral development remains a core responsibility; expansion into other channels must have a clear business case.
* Coach in the field
* Spend regular time with city managers and frontline representatives. Observe real meetings, diagnose the skills or account barriers involved and demonstrate effective discovery, value explanation, objection handling and next-step agreement. Give specific feedback and follow up on whether behaviour and results improve.
* Teach managers to coach their teams consistently. Use existing training materials and performance data to identify development needs. Translate training into practice through joint visits, role-play, account reviews and individual development plans. Measure improvements in representative productivity and target attainment.
* Build a capable sales organisation
* Clarify responsibilities, territory coverage, manager spans and account ownership. Set hiring standards, interview and assess sales talent, improve onboarding and ramp-up, and address persistent underperformance. Make staffing proposals based on workload, geography and account opportunity.
* Create a culture of preparation, honest reporting and reliable follow-through. Recognise results and effective behaviours, and ensure reviews lead to useful decisions. Develop managers who can sustain performance without every issue escalating to the national leader.

Events collateral and commercial execution
  
  

* Create events that develop business
* Design and execute targeted clinician roundtables, facility visits, educational discussions and other relevant engagement formats. Choose the audience and format around a specific account opportunity or referral barrier. Work with clinical colleagues on content and marketing colleagues on invitations and delivery.
* Own the commercial plan for each event: target accounts, proposition, attendee recruitment, approved budget, representative preparation, intended next actions and follow-up. Track full costs and evaluate qualified opportunities, productive accounts and attributable revenue over an agreed period.
* Assign follow-up owners before the event. Ensure opportunities are recorded and progressed in the CRM. Distinguish newly generated business from influence on existing opportunities. Use results to decide which formats to repeat, improve or discontinue.
* Know what sales collateral to build
* Audit existing materials and identify gaps by audience, sales stage and recurring question or objection. Brief marketing on assets such as referral guides, clinical capability summaries, evidence-based case examples, care-journey explanations, FAQs, presentations and event follow-up material.
* Specify the audience, purpose, message, evidence, format and intended next action for each asset. Work with clinical leaders to validate clinical content and with marketing to maintain brand consistency. Test material in real conversations, teach teams to use it and improve it based on feedback and account progression.
* Strengthen execution across teams
* Use existing CRM and reporting systems to maintain account plans, activity quality, source attribution, next actions and forecasts. Improve data quality and sales processes where a specific performance gap warrants it. Lead reviews that result in decisions and completed actions.
* Work with admissions and customer care to ensure referral enquiries receive timely attention and a clear handoff. Escalate repeated service or coordination barriers that damage partner trust. Support the clinical team's patient conversations through relevant information and feedback while respecting assigned ownership.
* Exercise sound healthcare judgment
* Represent Sukoon accurately and communicate value with evidence. Protect patient confidentiality and ensure patient stories and clinical claims have appropriate approval. Build trust with clinicians, partners and families through clear, respectful communication.
* Clinical decisions remain with clinicians. Commercial targets must support clinically appropriate care and informed patient choice. You are accountable for referral-channel performance and sales execution; clinical recommendations and lengths of stay are not sales decisions

**How Accountability Will Work**

* Revenue and admission outcomes depend on clinical eligibility, patient choice, facility capacity and patient-facing execution. You will own the sales actions and account relationships within your control, diagnose shared barriers and coordinate resolution. Reviews will distinguish weak sales execution from other causes of performance variance.
* Productive-account and conversion definitions will use consistent windows and denominators. Registered contacts and raw visit counts will not substitute for qualified opportunities or account outcomes. Count unique referrals consistently and avoid duplicate revenue credit across channels and events.
* The scorecard will inform priorities and performance assessment. Incentive terms and weightings will be specified separately in the employment offer.

**What Strong Performance Looks Like**
City managers can explain their account priorities and coach their teams effectively. Representatives understand partner needs, communicate Sukoon's value and secure meaningful next steps. Events create opportunities that are followed through, and collateral solves specific sales problems. Forecasts are reliable and the team can demonstrate progress against targets.
  
  
**Requirements**
**Must Haves**

* Demonstrated commercial experience in healthcare in India, including clinician or referral-partner engagement. A record of leading sales or business-development teams, owning targets and improving results through personal intervention is essential.
* Ability to show field coaching, territory and account development, revenue-generating events and sound sales-collateral judgment. Strong commercial numeracy, CRM discipline and cross-functional execution. Willingness to spend substantial time in the field and travel regularly between markets.
* Typically 12 or more years of relevant commercial experience, with meaningful people-leadership responsibility. We will consider strong regional leaders ready for national responsibility as well as established national leaders. Evidence of performance and capability will carry more weight than title or tenure alone.
* Bachelor's degree required. An MBA or relevant postgraduate qualification is preferred. Clear professional communication in English is essential; language capabilities relevant to our markets are valuable

**Good to have**

* Direct hospital or specialty-healthcare service sales
* Multi-city or multi-facility leadership
* Referral-account development involving complex patient decisions
* Effective work with consultants, marketing and admissions teams.
* Experience in mental healthcare, rehabilitation or addiction services is valuable but not mandatory.
